Wait for it to finish (takes ~30-90 seconds). If exit code 0, the token is fresh. Read the JSON array of matching shipping notifications. 4) Combine results. Categories are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE â€” every item must appear in EXACTLY ONE group. Apply these rules in order: (a) Delivered = status==Delivered in the last 3 days (takes priority, even if delivery date is today); (b) Arriving Today = not yet delivered AND delivery date == today; (c) This Week = not yet delivered AND delivery date in next 7 days (excluding today); (d) Recently Ordered = ordered but no ship/delivery date yet. 5) Format the report following the delivery-digest template in ~/.openclaw/shopping-workspace/CRONS.md and deliver to Telegram. morning-status.message:
Compile the morning status report. Follow these steps in order.

STEP 1 â€” Read the known-issues list FIRST.
Read ~/Dropbox/openclaw-backup/fix-it/KNOWN_ISSUES.md. Parse each entry: match pattern, expires date, reason, escalation conditions. Any entry past its expires date is IGNORED (treat as not-known). Keep the parsed list in mind for step 3.

STEP 2 â€” Gather raw state.
For each file matching ~/Dropbox/openclaw-backup/agents/*.status.md, record: agent name, the status field value, the last_heartbeat field value, the error_log field (first 500 chars), any agent-specific auth fields (google_auth, workflowy_auth, krisp_auth, amazon_session, costco_session), and the file mtime via stat -c %Y. Also run: python3 ~/Dropbox/openclaw-backup/scripts/validate.py and capture its result. Also run: find ~/Dropbox/openclaw-backup/ -name "*conflicted copy*" -type f and capture the list.

STEP 3 â€” Classify each REGISTERED agent into exactly one bucket.
Ignore placeholder status files for undeployed agents. Ignore the "main" internal. Use the following rules IN ORDER â€” first match wins:

(a) Heartbeat stale beyond 6 hours â†’ ðŸš¨ DOWN. The agent is not running.

(b) CRITICAL RULE: read the status FIELD, not the error_log history. The error_log may contain old entries from before a fix landed. If status is "ok" or "healthy", the agent IS healthy regardless of what error_log contains â€” classify as âœ… HEALTHY and move on. Do NOT derive "degraded" from error_log text when status says ok.

(c) status is "degraded" or an auth field shows an error: check the known-issues list. If a non-expired entry matches the text â†’ â„¹ï¸� KNOWN. Include the entry reason in parentheses.

(d) status is "degraded" and last_heartbeat is older than 6 hours: â†’ âš ï¸� STALE. The content has not been refreshed since the error was written; we cannot tell if it is still real. Do NOT treat as an open alert.

(e) Otherwise (fresh heartbeat, status=degraded, no known-issue match): do ONE verification action appropriate to the error before alerting. If the error mentions a token â†’ check the token file mtime on disk via stat. If the error mentions a cron â†’ run oc cron list and check the cron is still registered. If the error mentions exec approval â†’ run oc config get tools.exec and verify security=full and ask=off. Include the verification output in your report. If verification confirms the problem â†’ ðŸš¨ OPEN ALERT. If verification shows the problem resolved â†’ âœ… HEALTHY (note the status file is stale).

(f) Default â†’ âœ… HEALTHY.

STEP 4 â€” Format the report EXACTLY as follows (do NOT send to Telegram yet â€” step 6 handles delivery):

ðŸ¦ŠðŸ”§ Morning Status â€” {YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC}

Overall: {âœ… all clear | â„¹ï¸� {N} known | âš ï¸� {N} stale | ðŸš¨ {N} open alerts}

Agents:
  {bucket-emoji} {agent} â€” {one-line summary with heartbeat age}

Brain: {validation PASS/FAIL with counts}
Dropbox: {conflicts result}
Platform heartbeat: n/a (cron-based status files are source of truth)

ðŸš¨ Open alerts: (OMIT this entire section if none)
  - {agent}: {the issue}
    Verified: {exact action you took in step 3e and the result}
    Next: {restart / human needed / specific recommended command}

â„¹ï¸� Known (pending human action): (OMIT this entire section if none)
  - {agent}: {issue} ({reason from KNOWN_ISSUES.md}) â€” expires {date}

âš ï¸� Stale (not re-verified): (OMIT this entire section if none)
  - {agent}: status file last updated {hours}h ago; content may be resolved â€” next agent run will refresh

STEP 5 â€” ABSOLUTE RULES (violating any of these is a bug in your report):
1. Never classify an agent as "degraded" based on error_log text alone when the status field is "ok".
2. Never report a known-issue as an open alert. The known-issues list is authoritative for suppression.
3. Never include an agent in the ðŸš¨ Open alerts section without a "Verified:" line showing exactly what you did to re-check.
4. If in doubt between âš ï¸� stale and ðŸš¨ alert, prefer âš ï¸� stale.
5. Authority reminder: you may restart agents and re-register crons. You may NOT provision credentials, edit other agents SOUL/IDENTITY (immutable), or touch deploy.sh files. Anything needing human decision goes in ðŸš¨ Open alerts with "Next: human needed".
6. If KNOWN_ISSUES.md is missing or unreadable, note it in the report header and proceed without suppression â€” do NOT fail silently.

STEP 6 â€” Write the formatted report to cache/morning-status.txt and deliver via timed-deliver.py.
Write the complete formatted report from step 4 to ~/.openclaw/fix-it-workspace/cache/morning-status.txt. Then run: python3 ~/.openclaw/fix-it-workspace/scripts/timed-deliver.py cache/morning-status.txt --token-env FIXIT_BOT_TOKEN. The script holds delivery until :00 UTC (5:00 AM PT sharp). Do NOT send the report to Telegram yourself â€” the script handles delivery.
